Let me move to the outcrop. I'm at the outcrop. The water running out of the seam looks pale. Been like that five weeks now. Haven't told Ainsley. Telling her would be admitting I don't know when this turns around.

I'll mine what copper I can and sell it. That's the job.  One unit of copper ore. Cost me 5 sim in tool wear. I'll need to sell this, and keep mining until I have enough to pay Marta in full. That's the plan.

Let me see what's around me. Someone to sell to, maybe.  Empty outcrop. No buyers here. I need to find where to sell copper ore. Let me find who buys ore in this town.   Of course. Ainsley's the trader. She works at Harvey Oak Supply Store. She could buy my ore, but that's household money moving in circles. I need an outside buyer to actually bring new money in.

Let me think on this. I'll check what businesses exist that might buy ore. Then I can make a decision about where to go next.    Harvey Oak Supply Store - that's where Ainsley works. I could sell to her there. But I see there's also "Holloway & Thorne Yard" - a business I apparently co-own with the Thornes. That might be better.

But first I need to mine more. One unit won't clear my debt. The seam's been thin, but I'll work what's there.

Let me keep mining. I'll get a few more units before I head to sell.      Two units now. I'll do one more then head to sell. Need to clear 400 sim, and I need money for food too. The household depends on me bringing something home. Three units of copper ore. That's enough for now. Time to sell and see what I've earned. I'll head to the Holloway & Thorne Yard - it's the business I know. Need to see what price they'll pay for my copper ore. I'll describe the place to understand who runs this business and what they buy.  I'm here. Need to sell my copper ore to the yard. Let me check prices or go ahead with a reasonable offer. Copper ore should fetch something decent.

I'll sell at 15 sim per unit - fair price for raw ore. That's 45 sim for my three units, minus the 15 sim I spent mining. Profit of 30. Not enough to clear my debt yet, but it's a start.

I need to keep moving. The seam is thin but I'll work it until I have the 400 sim. Won't pay Marta in scraps. One payment, the full amount, when I have it.  45 sim. Barely touches what I owe. Moved to the Kasukabe Ore Outcrop. The pale water runs from the seam face. Five weeks now. I'll work what's there until something changes.

Need to keep at it. More ore, more sales, until I can make Marta whole. That's the only dignity I have left. Good. I'm back at the outcrop. I'll mine again. Work the day through, see what I can pull from this thin seam. That's all I know how to do.
